hints.tr: `environment:` altında iki satır: `name:` ve `url:`; `concurrency:` altında `group:` ve `cancel-in-progress:`.
hints.en: Two lines under `environment:`: `name:` and `url:`; `group:` and `cancel-in-progress:` under `concurrency:`.

hints.tr: İş `needs: deploy-staging` ile başlar; adımlar staging işindekilerle aynı, yalnızca hedef `production`.
hints.en: The job starts with `needs: deploy-staging`; the steps are the same as the staging job's, only the target is `production`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install build
      - run: python -m build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
  deploy-staging:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
      - run: python scripts/deploy.py staging
  deploy-production:
    needs: deploy-staging
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://app.example.com
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
      - run: python scripts/deploy.py production
```
